title: Redwood Office Hours — pick the best slot for your team
content:
message_1_body:
Hi all,

We run a weekly group office hours slot for teams evaluating Redwood — short demos + Q&A, focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and integration paths. Several of you signed up in the last week; to keep things useful we want to consolidate into the best single session that works for most.

Proposed 45-minute options (PST):
- Tue Dec 7 — 10:00–10:45 AM PST
- Wed Dec 8 — 1:00–1:45 PM PST
- Thu Dec 9 — 4:30–5:15 PM PST

Please reply with which slot your team prefers and how many attendees. If none work, let me know your preferred time window and timezone. I attached a provisional calendar invite (redwood-office-hours-v1.ics) — we’ll update and send the final invite once we lock the time.

Agenda (brief):
- 10 min: quick intros + use-case notes
- 20 min: short demo of hosting/dedicated/private flows (focus on latency/cost)
- 10 min: live Q&A and next steps (pilot, eval plan)

If there are specific topics to cover (billing model, SOC2 controls, dedicated capacity sizing), flag them in your reply and we’ll add it to the agenda.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123


message_2_body:
Hannah — thanks for organizing.

We can do Wed Dec 8 at 1:00 PM PST. It will be me + one engineer (two attendees). Could you also include a one-page note on expected token costs for a 1k qps burst vs. steady 50 qps? We're trying to compare the Dedicated reserved vs. hosted options.

Also quick question: will the session include a short pre-demo setup (we have a small dataset we'd like to discuss ahead of time)? If so, I can share a sample prompt.

Best,
Jared
Jared Cole
Head of Data Platforms, Acme Retail
jared.cole@acme-retail.com | +1 (206) 555-3400

message_3_body:
Hannah / Marissa — forwarding Jared's reply. Wed 1pm PST looks like the frontrunner. Two quick operational notes: 

1) Capacity: we should cap attendee seats at 8 for that slot to keep the session interactive; I can field questions on Dedicated pricing and bring a short cost comparison slide (will use the redwood-quick-overview.pdf).
2) Pre-demo asks: if Jared shares a sample prompt/dataset we can prepare a 5-minute targeted run on our staging model so the demo is concrete. Recommend we request sample by Tue EOD.

I can also offer an alternate Fri 9:00 AM PST slot if we need more capacity.

—Sean

message_4_body:

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: RW2026)
Calendar: attached updated invite (redwood-office-hours-v1.ics)
Pre-reads: redwood-quick-overview.pdf (attached) — one slide has a sample token-cost chart; Sean will expand that into a short comparison doc and drop it in the Drive link below by Tue noon.

Jared: if you can share the sample prompt/dataset by Tue EOD, we'll run a quick staging example during the session. If you'd rather share privately, send it to me and Sean directly.

Attendees so far (for headcount): Jared Cole (Acme) — 2; Katie Lin (Flux Systems) — 1; Andre Gomez (BrightAI) — 1. Max seats: 8. If your team size changes, please tell us.

Agenda reminder: intros (10m), targeted demo + cost comparison (20m), live Q&A + next steps (15m). We'll record and share the short recording and the Drive folder with the slides and a one-pager cost sheet after the call.
